pairs.note: Same name. Generic counts anyone served, inside or outside. The generated row for another team waiting already treats an internal team as the customer. No row dropped.

Same name. Generic adds asking for help before a problem becomes a surprise, and that exceptional results do not excuse behavior that damages trust. Rows score hiding a slip, taking the credit, and softening bad news as under. None treat results as an excuse. No row dropped.
Same name. Generic adds help for a struggling colleague and company success ahead of empire building. The two-teams over cell is taking over both efforts so you can be the owner. No row dropped.

Same name. Both sit on are-right-a-lot and ask-who-disagrees. The quiet room is the shared slice. The rest of the table is judgment, other perspectives, and changing your mind when the fact shows up. Teaching and Further reading stay the reused text.
Same name. Generated rows fit asking, trying a bounded new path, and carrying the answer back into the work. No row dropped.

Same name. Looking outside the team, and a new approach that people are still unsure about, stay on invent-and-simplify. Cutting steps that never change a decision is cut-the-extra-step, the same slice as Amazon.

Amazon name is Insist on the Highest Standards. Generic says not to confuse excellence with unreasonable demands. The pushback row scores refusing every cut and working late as over, which fits. No row dropped.

Same name. Generic adds the culture bar and that urgency does not justify lowering it. Interview and referral rows already score filling a seat and softening the standard as under. hire-and-develop-the-best is still not the map for Intentional About Culture. team-for-the-outcome is shared with that principle. best-person-for-the-role stays on the hiring decision. No row dropped.

Same name. Generic credits colleagues whose strength is focused delivery, detail, and disciplined operation. Under cells score missing the larger outcome. Just-right cells still require this week's delivery. No row treats that delivery as the failure by itself. No row dropped.

Same name. Generic states the reversible versus hard-to-undo split in the definition. Every generated row already turns on that split: act on the reversible choice, keep the review that would catch a hard-to-undo mistake. No row dropped.

Same name. Generic says growing headcount, budget, or fixed expense is not an achievement. The slipping-project under cell is asking for people before looking at scope. The over cell is turning down help the team actually needs. That still fits. No row dropped.
Same name. Generated rows fit staying in the details, sampling the items that would hurt, and tracing a slip to the real blocker. No row dropped.

Same name. Generic adds curiosity and shared learning after the outcome, not I told you so. Rows score relitigating a settled decision as over and building the chosen path as just right. No row dropped.
Same name. Generic says hours, effort, and tenure are not substitutes for delivery. Rows score a usable result and an early risk call, not hours logged. No row dropped.

The public counterpart is Strive to be Earth's Best Employer. That principle is not in this corpus, so there is no teaching to copy. intentional-about-culture, its rows, and the teaching were authored from this principle's definition. team-for-the-outcome is also mapped here. best-person-for-the-role stays on the hiring principles. The hire-and-develop-the-best table was not used as a substitute.
